note: Small private RV park on the south edge of Chappell, off the I-80 exit 85 road (US-385) just south of the railroad and grain elevators; ~30 full-hookup sites (30/50 A) in gravel rows on open grass. First come, first served, cash or check only; busy in wheat harvest (late June-July), so call ahead. Train noise. Operator asks that you follow directions rather than GPS. --Claude
summary: Private gate passes. Price: $30 a night in the 2024 Passport America guide, matched by a June 2024 camper report. Presence: Google 4.4 from 147 reviews plus the phone; there is no operator website. The PA 2024 listing confirms FCFS, cash or check only, 30 RV sites, and 30/50 A full hookups. The stored website is an unclaimed RoverPass page, which should be removed. Pin OK (on the office; RV rows 40-80 m west). Not waterfront.
